documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited (Standalone And Consolidated) Financial Results For The Quarter And Half-Year Ended On 30Th September 2026
COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, highlighting year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax. Management discussed portfolio expansion into new Mumbai micro-markets like Santacruz and Khar, steady project execution across ongoing sites, and stable housing demand in the region. The company addressed challenges from the war situation impacting input costs and margins during the quarter, while outlining a healthy GDV pipeline for upcoming redevelopment projects. Modis Navnirman Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations growing by 27.9% year-on-year to Rs 58.26 crore and PAT rising by 25.8% to Rs 8.54 crore. Management highlighted steady construction progress across key ongoing projects such as Rashmi Square, Rashmi Signature, Rashmi Delight, Rashmi Manorath, Rashmi Icon, and Rashmi Avenue, along with the successful securing of a new redevelopment project.

guidance.claim: Management expects healthy margins of around 20% to 30% in every project.
guidance.quote: But a healthy margins of around 20% to 30% should be expected in every project.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that pricing trends have been similar and stable across key micro-markets without much volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: No, there are no price ~ pricing trends have been similar to what it is.

demand_outlook.claim: Management believes demand is going to be on the higher side rather than the lower side for the next few years.
demand_outlook.quote: So, demand in terms of demand, I'm very skeptical that it is going to go on a higher side rather than on a lower side.

demand_outlook.claim: Median age of 29 years is driving housing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Median Age: 29 years driving housing demand

capex_expansion.claim: The company currently has six ongoing projects, 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects taking the total portfolio to 25 premium residential projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Together with this, currently we have six ongoing projects and 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects across Bombay and its region, taking our portfolio to 25 premium residential projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully secured another new redevelopment project during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q1 FY27, construction progressed steadily across key projects, including Rashmi Square, Rashmi Signature, Rashmi Delight, Rashmi Manorath, Rashmi Icon and Rashmi Avenue, reinforcing our commitment to timely delivery and quality execution.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired two new projects named Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold.
capex_expansion.quote: Upcoming projects include Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold which we have recently acquired.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew by 14.2% to X11.65 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Modis Navnirman Limited delivered a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% to %58.26 crore, while EBITDA grew by 14.2% to X11.65 crore and PAT rose by 25.8% to X8.54 crore, reflecting disciplined execution, operational efficiency, and the strength of the Company's redevelopment-led business model.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that margins saw some moderation due to project mix, execution, and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects.
margins_costs.quote: While margins saw some moderation due to project mix and execution and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects, we believe this is temporary and our long-term margin profile remains healthy.

orders_capacity.claim: Area sold during Q1 FY27 reached around 44,000 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: One number I want to specifically mention is the area sold, which in Q1 FY27, we have sold around 44,000 square feet.

orders_capacity.claim: Rashmi Square inventory is nearly 80% sold off.
orders_capacity.quote: See, Rashmi Square has been nearly sold off around 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: Rashmi Delight inventory is nearly 40% sold off.
orders_capacity.quote: Then goes Rashmi Delight, Rashmi Delight has nearly gone around 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: Rashmi Manorath sales are nearly around 20% to 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: And other than that Manorath, Manorath sales is nearly around at 20%-25%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 lakh is booked and 2.40 lakh available inventory.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 is booked and 2.40 lakh available inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: Management emphasized that the company remains debt-free despite rapid growth.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still debt-free despite rapid growth. We continue to maintain our debt-free model.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rashmi Govind Dalvi project is a little on hold because the government has put a stay in the whole area of that 500-meter section.
risks_headwinds.quote: Rashmi Govind Dalvi project is a little on hold. So, projects will be going into this year, starting this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Foreign investment share in real estate inflows dropped to 13% in Q1 2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: Foreign FDI Pullback: Foreign investment share down to 13% in Q1 2026

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the war situation has impacted raw material costs to a minor extent.
risks_headwinds.quote: So in terms of the war situation has impacted us, but not majorly because currently the execution stage which is at this level, the raw material impact is at a lower level to us.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding the redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding our redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value for all stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Rashmi Square will be delivered in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We will be delivering that project in FY27. This year we'll be delivering Rashmi Square.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
